text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired: INC-2065 - high error-rate on inference-gateway (5xx spike) across eu-west1 and us-central1. Alert threshold: 8% 5xx in 2m. Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2065 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Auto-acknowledged by on-call rule (rotation: alex). Escalation in 5m if not acknowledged.

alex: I'm oncall and acking. Looking into traces and recent deploys. Can someone check routing policy changes from last 15m?

maria: saw a small routing-policy rollout 10m ago (smart-routing v2 -> prefers low-latency quantized variants). I'm pulling audit logs now.

sam: adding logs: 
```
[2026-03-14T22:11:02Z] gateway: forwarded request to model-quant-2 -> 503 upstream_connection_reset
[2026-03-14T22:11:03Z] gateway: forwarded request to model-quant-2 -> 503 upstream_kv_cache_miss
[2026-03-14T22:11:04Z] gateway: fallback attempted -> model-std-1 -> 200
```

jamie: interesting — fallback worked for some requests but not consistently. Looks like smart-routing is overloading the quantized pool and then failing before fallback kicks in. Could be queuing / connection limits.

alex: Confirmed spike: 5xx from quantized pool nodes (dedicated cluster). Opening the Dedicated dashboard — KV cache stress metrics spiking and connection resets.

infra-bot: Autoscaler event: scale-up request for cluster-quant-2 queued (reason: conn_errors > 30 over 60s). Provisioning delayed due to quota. Ticket opened: https://infra.example/tickets/6792

maria: Quota delay explains the backlog. For immediate mitigation: can we disable smart-routing to quantized variants (force gateway to standard models) or throttle traffic to quantized pool?

alex: I'm going to flip routing: set routing.policy.quant_preference = 0 (force use of standard models). Will do a targeted change with short TTL.

sam: +1 for config flip. Also recommend temporary global 429 rate-limit for non-critical routes to reduce burst.

alex: Executing change now. 
```bash
# turn off quant preference for smart routing
redwoodctl routing set --policy smart-routing --set quant_preference=0 --scope global --note "incident: route away from quant pool"
```

alex: Change applied. Watching metrics.

(1m later) 

alex: 5xx rate dropping from 9.2% -> 2.1%. Latency on standard models increased ~60ms but within SLO.

maria: Confirming. KV cache ERR reduced on quant pool. Autoscaler still provisioning but should be lower priority now.

jamie: Noted customer impact: small fraction of requests to real-time endpoints saw degraded throughput during the 8min window. No major customer-facing 503s (most requests were successfully served via fallback).

sam: Suggested follow-ups: 1) audit smart-routing rollout steps and add canary target for quant pool, 2) increase autoscaler soft limits for quant pool, 3) add faster fallback hook to avoid in-flight failures.

alex: I'm handing off to maria for post-incident actions and writeup. Oncall off in 30m.

maria: Taking it. Will open an incident postmortem draft, include timeline, mitigation, and recommended action items. Also will coordinate quota increase with infra if needed.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2065 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-14T22:13:05Z. Resolved condition cleared at 2026-03-14T22:24:15Z.

incident-bot: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/routing-fallbacks — follow section "quantized-pool-backpressure" for root-cause checklist.

maria: Quick notes for the postmortem: root cause appears to be an un-canary'd smart-routing policy that shifted a significant portion of traffic to a capacity-constrained quantized pool while autoscaler quota was delayed, causing connection resets and temporary 5xx spike. Mitigation was to revert routing preference -> standard models, and apply temporary throttles.

alex: Great work team. Going to update the oncall rotation. :thumbsup:

sam: Adding follow-up: schedule a traffic-table test for quant pool and add synthetic load tests to detect queue/backpressure before routing rollouts.

maria: I'll assign action items and ping infra + product to coordinate safer rollout gating. Drafting postmortem now.

jamie: tagging product: @product-infra FYI on rollout gating and autoscaler quotas.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2065 status: mitigated. Please add notes to the incident timeline and close when postmortem ready. :white_check_mark:
